title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E05 — Kodiak Sea Monster
A mysterious apex predator is stalking orcas and boats off the coast of Kodiak, AK; sea monster sightings, first studied by Sanderson before his death, have spiked in that area recently.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E06 — Cave Dragon of Arkansas
When Ozarks locals report frightening encounters with a mysterious, dragon-like beast, the team conducts their most ambitious hunt yet.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E02 — Snow Beast of Ruby Creek
The team investigates recent encounters with a monstrous apex predator in the wilderness of British Columbia; using never-before-seen clues from Ivan Sanderson's lost archive, they uncover new evidence that may finally distinguish fact from fiction.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E03 — Thunderbird of Pennsylvania
The team makes a discovery while investigating sightings of a large bird of prey terrorizing Chestnut Ridge, Pennsylvania; Sanderson believes it to be the mysterious thunderbird, a razor-clawed predator documented in Native folklore.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E04 — Mystery of the Minnesota Wildman
The team investigates a stranger-than-fiction murder mystery involving the Wildman of Minnesota; known as the Ice Man, its body became a sideshow attraction that Sanderson examined himself before it mysteriously disappeared.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E01 — Mountain of Madness Part 1
Zak and the crew travel to Casper, Wyoming, to investigate local reports of UFO sightings, alien abductions and hauntings near an ominous mountain and abandoned military base; will a massive storm prevent the team from unraveling the mystery?

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E02 — Mountain of Madness Part 2
Zak and his crew push higher atop Casper Mountain into the world of storied witches; their investigation leads to a haunted forest where annual summer solstice rituals may have opened a gateway to another dimension.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E03 — Hollydale Asylum of Hell
Zak and the crew uncover evidence of disturbing satanic rituals when they explore an abandoned medical complex in Downey, California, that once housed dangerously deranged patients.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E04 — Hospital of the Damned
Zak and the crew gain access to a shuttered Pasadena, California, hospital that has become a hotbed for devil worship; Zak suspects the evil originated with a heinous murder nearly 25 years ago.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E05 — Darkness of Belmont Park
Zak and his crew investigate phantom footsteps, laughter and spectral figures at a San Diego amusement park; they discover a dark cloud hangs over the beloved establishment, which has entertained millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E01 — Hunt for Petra's Lost Tombs
With unprecedented access, Josh digs in front of Petra's treasury; searching for clues to the mysterious civilization that created one of the new Seven Wonders of the World, Josh rappels a seven-story cliff face to perform a high-tech scan.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E02 — Petra's Secrets Revealed
Rewriting history, Josh helps discover a tomb at Petra's iconic Treasury; the twelve skeletons inside may belong to a royal family of Petra; state-of-the-art tech could finally decipher the charred fragments of ancient scrolls.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E07 — Looted Treasures of Cambodia
Pushing into remote jungles, Josh investigates one of the 20th century's biggest heists - looting of Cambodian statues worth hundreds of millions; Josh rappels into a crumbling pyramid and digs up a treasure trove of missing monuments.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E08 — Cambodia's Stolen Monuments
A clandestine meeting with a Cambodian looter puts Josh on the trail of multi-million-dollar stolen monuments; Josh dives into a murky moat, where he unearths a priceless lost statue and a missing piece of a national treasure.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E07 — America's MIA Heroines
In World War II's closing days, 18 American servicewomen were lost off the Ivory Coast. Armed with new technology and fresh insights from the crash archives, Josh joins Project Recover to guide the search for the heroines' lost C47 plane.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E06 — Chasing Africa's Atlantis
Josh dives the waters off Tanzania to find a lost city and its fortunes, search ancient shipwrecks and uncover what could be the walls of a lost city that traded riches.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E01 — Hunt for Alexander the Great
Josh is on the hunt for the lost tomb of Alexander the Great; he dives Egypt's coast, revealing ruins of Alexander's Royal Quarter; he tunnels under modern Alexandria, but a water pump malfunction puts everything at risk.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E02 — Alexander's Lost Tomb
Spanning Europe and Africa, Josh's chase for Alexander's remains and fortune ramps up; clues mount in a flooded ruin beneath Alexandria, Egypt; Josh gathers evidence Alexander's body may actually lie in Venice's St. Mark's Cathedral.

title: Gold Rush
description:

Forest fires threaten to shut down Parker's Sulphur Creek claim before he can get all the gold out; Rick decides whether to move back to Duncan Creek; Tony loses nearly $750,000 in gold battling a wash plant issue.

title: Gold Rush
description:

title: Deadliest Catch

Sig's crew races to jettison pots and repair a flooding compartment below deck. Rick radios Johnathan to help hide his honey hole, but when Jake spots the Time Bandit's unusual movements, he calls Rick's bluff.

title: Deadliest Catch

As Jake sets gear in heavy seas, a painful skin infection spreads among the Cornelia Marie crew.

title: Deadliest Catch

As 25-foot breakers pound the fleet, critical systems fail at the worst possible time; Sig's engine runs wild, Jake loses power, John's crane cracks and Rick must replace a lackluster deckhand, opening the door for the return of a favorite greenhorn.

Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.
